name: Trigger: OnFirstWindowOpen
purpose: File-open trigger of karbon_charts: contains only comment steps (explaining when the trigger runs) and no action. Effect owner if kept: client-ui.
open_question: Set as the OnFirstWindowOpen file option but does nothing. Compare karbon_data script 2, which seeds records.

name: Trigger: OnCloseLastWindow
purpose: File-close trigger of karbon_charts: when the multi-user state is not hosted-multi-user (2), sets multi-user on (hidden), goes to the "Widget Detail" layout, locks and hides toolbars, shows the menu bar and resets the window to 1028x768 at the top-left.
open_question: Window housekeeping only; set as the OnLastWindowClose file option.

name: Commander

Open Manage Database (step 6)
Open Script Workspace (step 8)
